# GigaInvestors

> What 83 widely followed investors own, updated every quarter from SEC 13F filings (via dataroma.com), drawn as treemaps with pencil-sketch portraits. Static site, no accounts, no tracking.

## When to use this site

Use GigaInvestors when a task needs any of these, for the tracked set of 83 investors (Buffett, Burry, Ackman, Tepper, Klarman, Li Lu, Pabrai and others):
- What an investor currently holds, position weights and dollar values, and what they bought, added, reduced or sold in the latest quarter (`/{CODE}`, e.g. `/BRK`).
- Which of these investors hold a given stock, how much, what share of their portfolio it is, since when, and whether they were buying or selling (`/s/{TICKER}`, e.g. `/s/NVDA`).
- Portfolio history back to 2006, quarter by quarter, including exited positions.

Do not use it for: real-time prices, short positions, non-US holdings, cash levels, fund performance, or anything about investors outside the tracked list. 13F data lags the quarter end by up to 45 days.

## How to read it programmatically

- Every page returns Markdown when requested with `Accept: text/markdown` at the same URL (canonical HTML otherwise; responses vary on Accept).
- Home `/` lists all investors with portfolio value and position count, and links to each page.
- Investor page `/{CODE}` lists positions (ticker, company, % of portfolio, value, this quarter's move, number of tracked holders) and portfolio value by quarter.
- Stock page `/s/{TICKER}` lists holders (investor, value, % of their portfolio, move) and total held by quarter with split-adjusted reported price.
- Investor codes are dataroma's manager codes (e.g. BRK, SAM, PI); the home page maps names to codes.
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml. Trust pages: /about, /contact, /privacy.

## Notes

- Values are quarter-end reported values; a "price" is value ÷ shares from the filings, split-adjusted.
- Green means buying (new or add), red means selling (reduce or sold), scaled by the size of the move.
- One investor (Norbert Lou) has no public photo; Makaira Partners (MP) is tracked but currently reports no 13F holdings, so its page shows an empty state.
